our method provides a powerful tool to study the nonlinear stability of periodic traveling waves for systems of dispensive equations.

the method developed in this paper is applicable to any system of dispersive equations for which the spectrum of the operator linearized around the periodic traveling-wave solution is known, and the existence of a suitable conservation law has been established.

we have established the orbital stability of traveling-wave solutions for the Liu-Kubotao-Ko system, and for the modified Kd V system, while the orbital stability of the traveling-wave solutions for a log-Kd V-type system has not been established yet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the method can be applied for the systems with the following properties: (1) the linearized operator has a simple spectrum; (2) the linearized equation has the same dispersion relation as the original system; (3) there exists a conserved quantity.
we have developed a new method for the stability of periodic-wave solution to systems of dispersive equation.
we can obtain the orbital stability of traveling-wave solutions for a large class of dispersive systems with nonlinear coupling terms.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the orbital stability of the periodic traveling waves is a consequence of the existence of the conserved quantity and the spectrum of the associated linear operator, without the need to use the explicit expression of the traveling waves.
, in some cases, it is possible to prove orbital stability of traveling waves without having to prove the existence of the associated modulation equations.
, in order to prove the orbital stability, it is enough to have the spectral properties and the existence of a suitable conserved quantity.
